name: Baliarnas
source:
Baliarnas – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change, an Aegis of Life.
Baliarnas' true form remains unknown. Om'verai imagine Baliarnas as an Om'verai-like creature with leaf-shaped eyes, blackened since he created the world. Baliarnas had paws with long fingers, back paws do resemble sticks. Baliarnas' belly is covered by light plates, wing membranes resemble sun rays, horns are curled and light-colored, back is covered by spikes and there is also a "beard".
